name: WolfStateFlags
meaning: u32 at descriptor+4. Evidence = the reader quoted.

name: WSF_LOOP_ANIM
meaning: Wolf_SetState passes flags&1 as the loop argument

name: WSF_STATIONARY
meaning: Set on standing/idle stances; msg 0x403 returns 1 only if neither 0x2 nor 0x4 (inferred meaning)

name: WSF_BUSY_OR_QUIET
meaning: Falls, sneaks, pick-ups; part of mask 0x8c004 that stops Wolf_SwapHeldItem from changing state; msg 0x403 (inferred meaning)

name: WSF_SLIDING
meaning: Wolf_Update does not reset the slope timer +0xc4 (slide states 9,0x67,0x8b,0xbb)

name: WSF_CAM_LEDGE_PROBE
meaning: Wolf::UpdateCamera: (stateD->flags & 0x10) && !(flags & 0x20) -> g_camReqFlags.ledgeProbe = 1 (verified)

name: WSF_NO_DISTANCE_COUNT
meaning: Wolf_MoveWithPlatform does not add to travelled distance +0x6d4; trail fx selector (rocket 0x54 only)

name: WSF_RUN_COLLISION
meaning: alt collision in Wolf_MoveWithPlatform; msg 0x40c 'is running'; run dust

name: WSF_GROUND_STATE
meaning: slope logic; msg 0x40e/0x427 'on ground'; footprints

name: WSF_ITEM_WHEEL_OK
meaning: quick inventory / item swap allowed

name: WSF_IGNORE_INPUT_FREEZE
meaning: msg 0xe (input freeze) ignored; object flag on enter (death/scripted)

name: WSF_BODY_FLAG0
meaning: Wolf_EnterState -> obj+0x78 bit 0

name: WSF_SKIP_BOX_TEST
meaning: Wolf_EnterState -> obj+0x3a bit 0x400

name: WSF_CAM_FIXED_PITCH
meaning: cam mode 0: request |=4 with angle 0x200 (umbrella air states)

name: WSF_CONTEXT_ACTIONS
meaning: Wolf_ScanContextActions runs

name: WSF_IN_WATER
meaning: no water re-entry; msg 0x41f; kill type 0 -> 0x4c

name: WSF_KEEP_COVER
meaning: keeps +0x634; msg 0x404 does the line-of-sight cover test

name: WSF_SHEEP_NIBBLE
meaning: msg 1/2 from Sheep: 20 s timer +0x6d8 then bush lost (state 0x64 only)

name: WSF_KEEP_ELASTIC
meaning: Wolf_EnterState / Wolf_DropHeld keep +0x668 link (0x72,0x73)

name: WSF_ITEM_IN_USE
meaning: held item gets the in-use message on enter; blocks swap (mask 0x2040000)

name: WSF_AIRBORNE
meaning: forces Wolf_IsFalling

name: WSF_LOOK_MODE_OK
meaning: first-person look allowed

name: WSF_WATER_COLLIDE
meaning: 0x486c1b uses sweep 0x511a12 (0x43,0x44,0x4c)

name: WSF_CAM_USE_WOLF_ANGLE
meaning: cam mode 0: request |=4 with wolf rot (0x44 swim)

name: WSF_ICE_BLOCK
meaning: attach ice-block model on enter / detach on leave; grab->0x4d, release->0x4b, geyser->0xdb

name: WSF_INTERACTING
meaning: passed to platform-push routine 0x49205d (arg 4); interaction states

name: WSF_UNTOUCHABLE
meaning: kill msg 0, catch 0x400/0x419 and most reaction messages refused; blocks item swap

name: WSF_MAGNET_DRAG
meaning: 0xc8/0xc9; part of msg 0x53 refuse mask 0x26084000

name: WSF_FLATTENED
meaning: msg 0x41c query; enables 0x41d; refuses 0x41b

name: WSF_FLYING
meaning: msg 0x41e query (updraft, black hole, rocket)

name: WSF_GHOST_CAPTURED
meaning: msg 0x420 query (0xda)

name: WSF_SMOKE_TRAIL
meaning: Wolf_UpdateTrailFx first selector (0x1c, 0xcf)

name: WSF_KILL_WHEN_DEAD
meaning: death zones and kill msg still processed although dead flag set (0xf, 0xa9)
